scope: repo-wide engineering, security, evidence, and release decisions
non_affiliation: OpenAI is used only as a public benchmark for safety-oriented company-grade rigor; this repository is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI.

value_functions.name: Safety before capability
value_functions.principle: No capability, speed, or benchmark improvement is allowed to bypass security, misuse, dependency, or fail-closed gates.
measurable_invariants: security-critical dependency floors are explicit and checked before trusted install
dangerous drift between scan, runtime, lock, and bootstrap surfaces fails CI
high/critical dependency vulnerabilities block release
failure_modes: scanner sees a weaker dependency universe than production
CI bootstraps with vulnerable installer tooling
security floor exists in prose but not in machine-verifiable manifest

value_functions.name: Truthfulness over presentation
value_functions.principle: A green check is valid only when it measures the relevant risk; decorative, skipped, or vacuum-green signals are treated as failures.
measurable_invariants: changed risk surfaces have a matching automated verifier
zero collected tests on a touched test surface is a failure
positive claims cite executable evidence or artifact hashes
failure_modes: test lane passes with zero relevant tests
manifest drift hidden behind stale artifact metadata
claim says verified while verifier never ran

value_functions.name: User and operator value
value_functions.principle: Every merged change must reduce operator uncertainty, reduce manual recovery cost, or increase validated decision quality.
measurable_invariants: failure output names the broken surface and next corrective command
new gates explain failure in action language, not opaque stack noise
docs distinguish product claims from experimental claims
failure_modes: red CI without actionable root cause
automation increases noise but not decision quality
operator has to infer hidden policy by reading multiple files

value_functions.name: Reproducibility and provenance
value_functions.principle: Results, artifacts, locks, and claims must be reproducible from declared inputs and content-addressable evidence.
measurable_invariants: lockfiles agree with security constraints
artifact manifests match current artifact hashes
generated evidence is separated from source intent
failure_modes: relock required but not committed
artifact hash drift
manual evidence file edited without regeneration

value_functions.name: Technical leadership through falsification
value_functions.principle: The repo should lead by creating better falsifiers, not by expanding claims faster than tests can kill them.
measurable_invariants: claim-critical modules have mutation or invariant probes
new capability claims include a failure-mode test
quality gates can detect deliberately planted regressions
failure_modes: new detector has no synthetic failing case
mutation floor cannot establish baseline
claim expands without a kill path

value_functions.name: Cooperative auditability
value_functions.principle: A competent external reviewer should be able to reconstruct what changed, why it matters, and how failure is detected.
measurable_invariants: new governance gates are documented by executable tests
failure messages identify manifest, package, version, and violated floor
policy is stored in repo data, not only in chat or PR prose
failure_modes: policy exists only as narrative
failure cannot be mapped to violated value function
reviewer cannot tell whether a green run is meaningful

value_functions.name: Minimal power concentration in automation
value_functions.principle: Automation may accelerate execution but must preserve human falsifier authority and make override points explicit.
measurable_invariants: automation emits verdicts, not unverifiable authority claims
hard constraints require evidence, not trust in agent output
manual override requires an explicit documented risk acceptance
failure_modes: agent-created green status without external evidence
implicit override hidden in config
automation collapses policy into unreviewed prompt text
